title: Antiviral Activity of Interferon Alpha-2b and Taurine Combination Against SARS-CoV-2 in vitro

sections.abstract: <jats:p>Interferons (IFN) have antiviral activity against many viruses, including SARS-CoV-2. A combination of IFN-a2b and the<jats:bold> </jats:bold>antioxidant taurine is widely used in the Russian Federation, and its antiviral activity has not been studied before. The aim<jats:bold> </jats:bold>of this study was to determine the antiviral activity of interferon drugs, in combination with taurine and without it. The<jats:bold> </jats:bold>study included cytotoxicity and antiviral activity assays of IFN-a2b preparations, when stored according to the instructions<jats:bold> </jats:bold>at 2–8°C, and after 1 month storage at the temperature of 20–26°C in a pre-opened state. The combination of IFN alpha-2b<jats:bold> </jats:bold>with taurine has a higher antiviral activity compared to IFN alpha-2b mono-preparation by more than 25% at a «low» and<jats:bold> </jats:bold>85% at a «high» multiplicity of infection. Selectivity index for combinations of IFN-a2b (50,000 IU/dose) + taurine (1 mg/ml)<jats:bold> </jats:bold>and IFN-a2b (10,000 IU/ml) + taurine (0.8 mg/ml) was more than 600 units, whereas for the IFN-a2b (10,000 IU/ml) it was<jats:bold> </jats:bold>200 units. Antiviral activity does not change after one month at room temperature. The combination of interferon with<jats:bold> </jats:bold>taurine at high concentrations was less toxic than interferon. The results obtained demonstrate practicability of interferon<jats:bold> </jats:bold>alpha-2b and taurine combination use for treatment and prevention of COVID-19.</jats:p>
